facts.rationale: Distinguishes the state-9 no-op from the timer/effect callback shared by states 5 and 6, resolving the rendered Roll_Anim collision without asserting an uncertain semantic state label.
The cleared vector stores previous world position in state 9 and previous bone translation during restoration; it is not a velocity output.

evidence.why: Reset and forwarding of the same vector.

facts.value: Clears all three components of the shell's previous-position scratch vector, zgshell.vel, without changing x40_vel or selecting a motion state. The storage is reused for state-9 world-position stall detection and restoration bone-translation deltas.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing bone-velocity description and records the vector's two distinct consumers.

facts.value: Forwards the supplied joint, Item, and &zgshell.vel to itUpdateVelocityFromBone. For a non-NULL joint, the shared helper reads joint translation, writes x40_vel.x = facing_dir * (pos.z - previous.z), x40_vel.y = pos.y - previous.y, and x40_vel.z = pos.x - previous.x; it then stores the current translation in zgshell.vel and clears the joint translation. A NULL joint leaves both velocity and history unchanged. The restoration caller supplies dynamic bone 1.
facts.rationale: Corrects the previous claim that zgshell.vel is the destination for velocity, preserving the NULL branch and actual output fields.

evidence.why: Restoration caller and subsequent velocity use.

facts.value: Refreshes the active ECB from xC0C, then tests ABS(x40_vel.x) < attrs->x8. At or above the threshold it invokes grounded active initialization. Below the threshold it clears all velocity components, runs it_80277040, and selects stopped setup when that predicate is false or invokes the guarded state-9 event handler when true. The predicate processes contact-normal/slope motion, not floor support; the state-9 handler does not assign GA_Air. This resolver is supplied by thrown, dropped, and state-7/8 collision callbacks.
facts.rationale: Corrects contradictory support interpretations and preserves threshold equality and all local callers.

facts.value: Handles the shared shell event named EnteredAir by preserving states 10 and 11 and otherwise clearing previous-position scratch and xE1C_b0, setting x1F, and selecting state 9. Despite its event label, this routine does not assign ground_or_air; grounded slope-motion callers also use it.
facts.rationale: Separates the established event name from the unsupported claim that state 9 is an airborne-mode assignment.

facts.value: Checks low-speed conditions for the callback shared by grounded states 5 and 6. The x8 threshold conditionally triggers common item/hitbox processing; an independent x30 threshold clears velocity and selects stopped state 0 when slope-motion processing returns false, or invokes the guarded state-9 handler otherwise. The source does not establish the relative ordering of x8 and x30 or perform gradual deceleration here.
facts.rationale: Removes unsupported threshold ordering and airborne interpretation while preserving the two independent tests.

facts.value: Processes grounded animation completion after restoration interruption. When the animation predicate is false and the item is grounded, a false it_80277040 result resets the shell into state 0. The alternate branch selects state 9 only if the current msid is neither 10 nor 11. Since it_80277040 does not change msid, an ordinary invocation while still in state 10 does not take that state-9 transition. The callback always returns false.
facts.rationale: Makes the exceptional exclusion explicit rather than presenting state 9 as a normal alternative recovery destination.

facts.value: Keeps restoration motion consistent with upward movement: when x40_vel.y is positive, it invokes it_802762BC to assign GA_Air and clear x1F. Zero or negative vertical velocity performs no work. Neither this callback nor that helper changes the velocity vector.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing classification of the callee as a velocity helper.

facts.value: Unconditionally forwards the shell to grZakoGenerator_801CACB8. After common cleanup, the non-Coin path reads the item's generator index; if it is not -1, it clears that entry's object pointer, sets its respawn timer to 0x708 when configured to respawn or -1 otherwise, and invalidates the item's index. The separate Coin path scans entries for pointer matches and must not be substituted for shell cleanup semantics.
facts.rationale: Corrects the previous pointer-ownership predicate and preserves generator respawn bookkeeping.

facts.value: Allocates It_Kind_ZGShell with zero initial velocity and returns NULL unchanged on allocation failure. On success it sets facing and xE10. A successful initial placement predicate first assigns GA_Ground: a false slope-motion predicate then enters state 0 with ordinary velocity cleared, while a true result selects state 9 only outside states 10/11, explicitly clearing zgshell.vel and setting x1F without assigning GA_Air. Failure of the initial placement predicate assigns GA_Air and enters state 1. The state-0 branch contains no explicit zgshell.vel reset.
facts.rationale: Corrects the state-0 scratch-reset claim and the conflation of x1F/state 9 with airborne status.

evidence.why: All constructor branches and allocation guard.
